objective: Reserve an exact Git branch with trusted metadata and post-launch outcome reconciliation
nonGoals: Defend against code already running as the trusted controller UID
acceptanceCriteria: atomic-ref|WHEN exact branch creation completes normally|ASSERT TEST_PASS git-reservation-proof
metadata-boundary|WHEN metadata parents alternates hooks or redirects are unsafe|ASSERT ERROR GitReservationError
runner-ambiguity|WHEN the ref commits before runner failure|ASSERT ERROR GitRefIndeterminateError
output-ambiguity|WHEN the ref commits with unexpected output|ASSERT ERROR GitRefIndeterminateError
